name: workplace
description: Dev orchestrator for the Workplace client, API server and socket server. Each app keeps its own package.json.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix socket install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server,socket -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix client start" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix socket run dev"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server && npm run lint:socket
